Purpose of this record

This portal documents a known electrical hazard at the Condominio El Oasis community pool area, first formally reported to the board on May 16, 2026. The conditions shown above were visible at ground level and required no specialized equipment or training to observe.

The record exists because owners are entitled to the same information documented here. Each chapter below adds to that record as events develop.

Documentation chapters

The original hazard report, photographic record, and correspondence with the board from May 16 through July 2026. Includes the Ministerio de Salud filing and the formal legal questions submitted to the board.
